blurb: Guests can enjoy European inspired beers and watch local and international soccer matches in a lively taproom and event space. The brewery hosts special events like the Soccer Fest World Cup watch party with large screens, DJs, games, and food pop-ups. The taproom offers a variety of draft beers, ciders, and non-alcoholic options, with indoor and outdoor seating including a heated patio.
